svg.text: STA L2 Connection: FWK Sequence (connect to Supplicant AIDL)
Config validation, admin restriction, deprecated security
Tear down secondary CMMs, stop MBB transient CMMs
Phase 2: ConnectHelper → CMM → ClientModeImpl — Connection dispatch chain
IpClient check, ScoreCard, FILS pre-connect, EAP TOFU
Stop ongoing scan before connecting to free radio
Phase 5: SupplicantStaIfaceHalAidlImpl — AIDL network setup and select
AIDL: setSsid, setBssid, setKeyMgmt, setPsk, setProto, EAP...
Inject cached PMK to skip full EAP auth on reconnect
Phase 6: wpa_supplicant internal — Auth→Assoc→EAPOL→4-Way Handshake (not covered in this article)
Phase 7: Supplicant state callback flow — AIDL callback back to Framework
AIDL callback from supplicant → newState, bssid, ssid
Phase 8: ClientModeImpl state handling — State transition to L2ConnectedState
Update WifiInfo (BSSID, SSID, freq), ScoreCard, broadcast
→ L3 provisioning (DHCP / IP config, covered in a subsequent chapter)
1 (Java Framework ↔ Native wpa_supplicant via AIDL boundary)
